name: CreateInstitutionApplication
input_summary: Identity, representative, contacts and terms
outcome: Draft application; invalid legal references rejected
guard: Server-issued applicant context only; legal reference validation; does not confer institutional privilege.

name: InviteMember
input_summary: Institution, email, roles, scope and expiry
outcome: Pending invitation; delegation and self-elevation checked
guard: Current verified institution, delegable role subset and scope, positive expiry; recipient cannot activate own privilege.

name: RevokeMembership
input_summary: Subject, scope, reason and expected version
outcome: Effective restriction and impact tasks within revocation target
guard: Lock subject membership; prevent removing last owner without accepted successor; apply online revocation target.

name: SubmitSolutionConfiguration
input_summary: Intended use, components, mode, dependencies and files
outcome: Frozen submission; quarantine or missing materials block review
guard: Exact component versions, quarantine clearance, provider rights and selected execution-mode prerequisites.

name: SubmitAccessRequest
input_summary: Dataset release, study, purpose, users, fields, region and period
outcome: Review package; discovery rights and scope validated
guard: Discoverable exact dataset release; study reference and purpose; requested interval positive; no implied grant.

study_ref.description: Study UUID in active tenant, or custodian-owned verified external_reference of kind study. Never an unchecked remote UUID.

name: DecideAccessRequest
input_summary: Frozen request, decision, approved subset and eligible signatures
outcome: Grant or denial; independence and all required rights checked
guard: Snapshot current; independent required owners; approved scope subset of request and all rights; approved_scope required only for approval.

name: RegisterImport
input_summary: Source manifest, rights and mapping
outcome: Quarantined import identity and controlled transfer route
guard: Current grant, approved source and mapping; transfer enters quarantine; no preview or search before clearance.

name: FinaliseImport
input_summary: Verified bytes, validation and reconciliation
outcome: Reconciled batch; missing inputs or integrity mismatch block acceptance
guard: Expected source digest and bytes; accepted + rejected + quarantined = source; counts nonnegative; no omitted records.

name: ReleaseDataset
input_summary: Members, labels, rights, partitions and quality decisions
outcome: Immutable manifest; leakage or quality blockers prevent release
guard: Immutable manifest, label quality, leakage/partition checks, rights, eligible quality decisions; sealed labels remain separate.

name: FreezeProtocol
input_summary: Complete plan, thresholds and review decisions
outcome: Frozen protocol; missing clinical rules or stale review blocked
guard: All endpoints, thresholds, sample and subgroup methods, failure rules, uncertainty and stop criteria complete and approved.

name: ActivateStudy
input_summary: Exact scope, gates, owners, versions and budget
outcome: Active study record; all applicable prerequisites rechecked
guard: Ready state; exact frozen protocol/config; G1/G2 and all applicable G4/G7/G8; current grants, owners, budget; no holds.

name: SubmitRun
input_summary: Manifest, grants, resources, egress and budget
outcome: Logical run plus attempt; same request deduplicated
guard: Lock study and budget; exact immutable manifest; active grants and allowed region/egress; admitted resource profile; reserve budget atomically.

name: CancelRun
input_summary: Run, reason and authority
outcome: Cancellation intent followed by observed result; no assumed remote stop
guard: Authorised run scope; terminal observations preserved; append intent then await observed termination; settle usage once.

name: RequestOutputExport
input_summary: Exact assets, recipient, purpose and format
outcome: Disclosure and rights review package; no immediate unrestricted link
guard: Exact assets, intended recipient/purpose; rights and disclosure review task; cannot directly create unrestricted delivery.

name: IssueEvidence
input_summary: Frozen dossier and eligible signatures
outcome: Immutable issued report and status identity; incomplete provenance blocked
guard: G3; frozen dossier, complete failures and deviations, claim provenance and eligible independent signers; immutable issued artifact.

name: PublishEvidenceView
input_summary: Approved view, rights and audience
outcome: Released view; changed bytes or recipients require renewed decision
guard: Separately approved audience and exact sanitized bytes; current rights and report status; confidential titles excluded.

name: SubmitExternalPackage
input_summary: Frozen package, verified channel, recipient and human authority
outcome: Dispatch record and independent receipt state
guard: Verified channel/recipient, previewed immutable package and human authority; durable dispatch then separate receipt.

name: RecordSafetyConcern
input_summary: Minimal concern and available scope or contact
outcome: Immediate case and triage task; missing optional facts do not block
guard: Any authenticated reporter may submit concern alone; other fields optional; attachment quarantine must not block initial intake.

name: ApplyHold
actor: CS SO or qualified governance owner
input_summary: Affected scope, authority and reason
outcome: Active restriction and impact records; historical evidence retained
guard: Immediate authorised scope containment; record independent hold owner and reason; create impact tasks.

name: RequestResumption
actor: Relevant independent CS or SO authority
input_summary: Remediation, verification and eligible decisions
outcome: Resume only after all applicable holds and gates pass
guard: Every applicable hold independently cleared, remediation verified, prerequisites refreshed; return only to prior valid state.

name: AuthoriseDeployment
input_summary: Site, use, configuration, buyer, permissions and acceptance
outcome: Site-specific authorisation; evaluation result alone insufficient
guard: G5 for exact site/use/configuration; verified local permission, buyer acceptance, training, fallback and funding.

name: RecordInstalledVersion
input_summary: Deployment, observed configuration and source time
outcome: Version observation and mismatch review where required
guard: Authenticated observed source and event time; observation cannot itself authorise deployment; mismatches trigger review.

name: SubmitMonitoringObservation
input_summary: Plan, source identity, event time and measurements
outcome: Validated observation or quarantine; duplicate events reconciled
guard: Current admitted source/plan; unique source event ID; finite observed values, null for missing statuses; retain event and receipt time.

name: RecordExternalDecision
input_summary: Issuer, reference, scope, dates and evidence
outcome: Unverified record until qualified verification completes
guard: Issuer evidence and positive validity interval; record as unverified; no automatic regulatory authority.

name: RequestDisposal
input_summary: Assets, basis, scope, rights and proposed action
outcome: Hold-aware assessment; no immediate destructive bypass
guard: Approved retention basis, dependency inventory and legal-hold assessment; request creates assessment, never immediate deletion.

name: CloseInstitution
input_summary: Inventory, accepted handover, revocations and retention
outcome: Scoped closure attestation with explicit residual duties
guard: Accepted handover, inventory, revocations, retention and residual duties; cannot orphan incidents or held records.
